name: Las Casas del Conde (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Las Casas del Conde (a tree on yellow and a black bend within a bordure of chain).
history: The municipal flag of Las Casas del Conde was approved on 8 June 2006, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 26 June 2006; it is a rectangle of proportions 2:3 formed of a gules (red) cloth with the municipal arms at the centre.
